author: Top Gear
description:
This is a Velocity Ford Mustang Fox Body, and it means Velocity Restorations – hailing from Pensacola, Florida, USA – has thoroughly re-engineered a classic third-generation (1979-1993) Fox Body Mustang. With everything from a 5.0 ‘Coyote’ V8 supercharged to 715hp, via a new (second) chassis and new suspension, to an interior with heated cloth seats, this is the world’s first and only Ford Mustang Fox Body restomod! 

🚗 Velocity Ford Mustang Fox Body
